name: HCW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Created in a 30-man battle royal at the federation's first pay-per-view and fought to a one-hour draw at its last, with the champion of record still holding it when the promotion closed.

name: HCW United States Championship
epitaph: Created in a 32-entrant tournament and formally retired by the federation's own broadcast in July 1997, replaced by the Television Championship.

name: HCW Television Championship
epitaph: Created in an eight-man tournament at British Invasion to succeed the retired United States Championship, and still held when the federation closed.

name: HCW Hardcore Championship
epitaph: Won on the federation's earliest cards and called its longest-reigning championship by the federation's own award show before changing hands to the wrestler who would later hold the World title alongside it.

name: HCW World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Created in a tournament, vacated once when its first champions were fired for disrupting a pay-per-view, and held twice over by the same team before the federation closed.

name: HCW Triangle Championship
epitaph: Created at the federation's largest surviving card, with a tournament to crown a new champion announced that October whose outcome does not survive in the held record.
